ModMetaData.name: Extinguish Refuelables Compatibility Patch - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Extinguish Refuelables Compatibility Patch Renew (unofficial), run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
It does not depend on the mod under test, on purpose: the remove-mod scenario loads a save with that mod taken out of the list, and the companion has to survive it. It loads after it.
